featured_reviews.name: Vipul J Meher
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at this shop was very disappointing. I bought a pair of JoyBean brand sandals for ₹1,500. The shopkeeper initially quoted ₹1,900, and after bargaining, I purchased them for ₹1,500. However, when I returned home and checked the brand’s official website, I found that the MRP was ₹1,399 and the selling price was ₹1,245. Moreover, the original price tag had been removed from the item.

It appears that inflating the price first and then reducing it during bargaining is a tactic used to make customers feel satisfied, while still giving the shopkeeper an unfair advantage.

This practice is misleading and unfair. I advise others to avoid such fraudulent shops. If you do visit, make sure to check the price tag and do not fall for the shopkeeper’s sweet talk.

featured_reviews.name: Anushka Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Kay.

I ordered a pair of heels and paid ₹2098, but when I received the product, it was defective. This clearly shows a complete lack of proper quality checks before dispatching items to customers.

When I contacted their team, I was told that an exchange was not possible and that I would instead receive a gift card. However, instead of issuing the full amount I paid, they are offering only ₹1999. This is completely unacceptable. Why should I bear a loss when the mistake was entirely on their end?

This is not just unprofessional—it is highly unethical. A company cannot send defective products and then refuse to refund the full amount paid by the customer.

Their product quality is poor, their service is careless, and their customer support is absolutely pathetic. There is no accountability whatsoever.

I strongly advise others to think twice before purchasing from this brand. This has been a very frustrating and disappointing experience.
